units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:11">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 11</cite> <he>של צפירא</he> (sandals) of goat’s hair.

Ib. V, 12 של צפורה (R. S. to Kel. XXVIII, 9 צפירה) (a strainer) of goat’s hair. Ib. IV, 14 של צפור ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.) mats of goat’s hair; Succ. 20ᵇ של סְפִירָא of (loosely woven) shag (v. Rashi in Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200); [Rashi, fr. ספר to shear: horse-hair from the mane or the tail].
